root: ^Tarun: My vessel is cursed with the stench of blood... I should’ve never taken that job.
^ I was a fool, lured by the beauty of that hunter... she’s got us chasing the devil, you know?
^ I barely escaped with my life trying to flee that vile island.
^Tarun: I tried to sink the ship... but I just couldn’t bring myself to do it.
^ You... do me a favor and sink it, will you? Too many bad memories... I just want to forget it all.

c-0: ^Tarun: Offering? No... I’m entrusting you to destroy it. I don’t want anything to do with it anymore...
c-1: ^Tarun: Better now that I’m off that cursed place... but I can’t go back to my ship. Too many bad memories...
^Tarun: Whatever you decide, promise me you’ll never sail to the Veilglades.
^ If you value your life, stay away from there. I’ve already said too much... if you’ll excuse me,
^ I’d best run as far away from this port as I can...
